Manager, Project Manager 
 Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our goal is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

We partner directly with senior Design leadership, Tower Chiefs of Staff, Human Resource Business Partners, and enterprise partners to execute excellent operational strategy, governance, business continuity, and associate engagement.
 We are seeking a Manager, Project Manager to join our team as a culture driver and operational orchestrator. In this role, you will help bring XD’s Associate Engagement strategy to life, driving associate engagement, connectivity, and culture across our organization. You will design and execute high-impact culture programs, establish core engagement ceremonies, and translate qualitative and quantitative sentiment into well-managed actions. This role requires a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, balances strategic thinking with tactical execution, and is passionate about championing the tech associate experience.

 Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

 6+ years of Project Management experience leading enterprise-wide associate engagement

 Our Mission 
People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

 High visibility projects

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist - Time Deposits & Safe Deposit Box (50% Travel)
jobs.description:
Job Description: 
 Are you someone who understands banking operations and enjoys helping others learn? Do you have experience working with Time Deposits (CD and IRA), Safe Deposit Box or New Accounts and want to take that knowledge beyond the branch? 
 CSI is looking for an Implementation Specialist - Time Deposits & Safe Deposit Box , to support financial institutions through core conversions and implementations. This is a great opportunity for someone with banking experience who wants to grow into a more technical, client-facing role while helping banks successfully transition to CSI solutions. 
 What You’ll Do  
 As an Implementation Specialist, you'll be involved in client conversions from start to finish, with a primary focus on Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes, correspondent balancing, and general ledger unposted balancing.  
 You’ll serve as a client-facing resource throughout the conversion process, helping ensure tasks are completed accurately and on schedule while training bank employees on their new systems and processes. 
 In this role, you will: 
 Support implementations and conversions involving Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes  
 Balance Time Deposit and Safe Deposit Box activity and reconcile related control accounts  
 Assist with balancing activities involving general ledger accounts, ACH activity, cash letters, and correspondent accounts  
 Balance and repair unposted general ledger items  
 Understand how CDs and IRAs work throughout their lifecycle, including account activity, distributions, and related banking processes  
 Work directly with bank employees during conversions, helping them locate accounts, understand system functionality, and complete balancing activities  
 Train client employees on CSI solutions and processes related to Time Deposits and other assigned products  
 Serve as a consistent client-facing point of contact throughout assigned portions of the conversion  
 Monitor assigned tasks and timelines to help keep conversions on schedule  
 Partner with specialists supporting DDA, loans, cards, project management, and other areas of the conversion  
 Stay current on CSI products and enhancements to provide effective client training and implementation support  
 What We’re Looking For  
 Must Have  
 At least 2 years of relevant work experience  
 Banking or financial institution experience  
 Working knowledge of CDs and/or IRAs  
 Experience that may include teller, frontline banking, new accounts, deposit operations, or similar banking responsibilities  
 Understanding of how deposit accounts and transactions move through a financial institution  
 Strong communication and customer service skills  
 Ability to work directly with bank employees and explain processes in a clear, approachable way  
 Basic Microsoft Excel skills, including copying/pasting information and using basic formulas  
 Ability and willingness to travel as required for client conversions  
 Education or job knowledge equivalent to college or university undergraduate education  
   What Will Help You Stand Out  
 Back-office or deposit operations experience  
 Strong IRA knowledge, including experience supporting IRA account activity and distributions  
 Experience balancing deposit accounts, control accounts, or general ledger activity  
 Experience with ACH, cash letters, or correspondent balancing  
 Previous involvement with a core banking conversion or system implementation  
 Experience training bank employees or customers  
 Familiarity with CSI solutions or NuPoint  
 Travel Requirements  
 Approximately minimum 50% travel, based on business needs and the conversion schedule  
 Travel is typically Sunday through Friday during onsite conversions  
 Some conversions may require up to two consecutive weeks onsite  
 Saturday work is required during conversions to support balancing and go-live activities  
 Travel frequency will vary based on conversion volume, bank size, and project complexity  
 Ability to travel regularly and work a flexible schedule during conversion periods is required  
 Why This Role?  
 If you’ve built your banking knowledge at a branch, in new accounts, or within deposit operations and are ready for something different, this role gives you the opportunity to take that experience directly to CSI clients. 
 You’ll learn the implementation and conversion process, work with different financial institutions, expand your knowledge of banking technology, and become part of the team responsible for helping banks successfully transition to CSI.
